title: Inside the House
label: ch:gu-inside-the-house
canDo: I can hear and say five everyday Gujarati household words, and read and write one of them.

payoff.summary: Five household words enter meaning-first by ear, one lesson each; an oral checkpoint scores listening and speaking apart, window reaches the page with signs taught before chapter 8, and an R1 return carries the chapter-17 family words back at their fourth spacing window.
